data.title: Yomiuri: Japan's MS&AD to Merge Life Insurance Subsidiaries
data.description:
By Daiki Kawasaki / Yomiuri Shimbun Staff Writer

MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings Inc. announced Thursday that it will merge its two life insurance subsidiaries around October 2028.

By combining the strengths of Mitsui Sumitomo Aioi Life Insurance Co. (MSI Aioi Life) and Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life Insurance Co. (MSI Primary Life), which have different product lineups and sales networks, MS&AD — a major Japanese non-life insurance company — aims to boost the group's product development and sales capabilities.

Premium income, which is equivalent to sales revenue, will total about 1.7 trillion yen after combining the two subsidiaries' figures. The new figure would rank ninth among Japanese life insurance companies, following T&D Holdings Inc. and Japan Post Insurance Co.

MSI Aioi Life focuses primarily on medical and other types of insurance products, which it sells through the group's non-life insurance agencies. MSI Primary Life, on the other hand, has products including single-premium whole life insurance and personal pension insurance sold through financial institutions such as banks.

"By combining the two companies' products, we will be able to get on a trajectory for further growth," said Shigeo Kudo, executive vice president of MS&AD, at a press conference on the day.

----

This article is from The Yomiuri Shimbun. Neither Dow Jones Newswires, MarketWatch, Barron's nor The Wall Street Journal were involved in the creation of this content.

data.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
data.description:
US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) recorded $582 million in net outflows on Thursday, led by a record withdrawal from BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT).

IBIT posted $541 million in outflows on Thursday, its largest single-day withdrawal since launching in January 2024, according to Farside Investors data. The figure surpassed its previous daily record of $528.3 million, set on Jan. 30, 2026.

IBIT shares closed Thursday at $35.08, down 0.8% for the session. The shares have fallen 24.2% over the past month and 29.4% year to date, according to Yahoo Finance.

Thursday marked IBIT’s third consecutive trading day of outflows, totaling nearly $900 million. The latest streak followed a single day of inflows on Monday, which ended 11 straight sessions of withdrawals totaling roughly $2.35 billion.

The selling brought US spot Bitcoin ETFs’ November outflows to $3.47 billion, pushing their 2026 net withdrawals to approximately $3.11 billion, according to SoSoValue data.

Bitcoin (BTC) traded at around $61,875 at publishing time, down 3% over the past 24 hours, according to CoinGecko. The crypto asset was down 9.8% over the past seven days.

The ETF withdrawals coincided with a broader market selloff Thursday, as Anthropic’s highly anticipated stock market debut failed to sustain gains in AI-related stocks, including Nvidia, amid concerns over high valuations and heavy spending on artificial intelligence.

data.title: SNDK Stock Falls Overnight: NAND Price Forecast Turns Bearish For 2027, According To TrendForce
data.description:
Key points:
  • TrendForce expects NAND flash prices to decline in 2027, with contract prices falling from Q1.
  • TrendForce lowered its Q4 2026 price-hike forecast to 8% to 13%, while spot prices have fallen more than 20%. 
  • SanDisk is prioritizing data center customers seeking reliable supply through long-term contracts.

SanDisk Corp. (SNDK) stock fell overnight after TrendForce turned bearish on NAND Flash pricing for 2027, warning that deep enterprise SSD order cuts from Chinese cloud providers will outweigh U.S. demand growth, as the memory maker completes its 8-for-1 stock split.

SanDisk stock traded 2% lower overnight, ahead of Friday.

TrendForce Cuts Q4 NAND Price Forecast As Spot Prices Slide

TrendForce’s research says the NAND market flips in 2027. The firm expects contract prices to start sliding in the first quarter, dropping 0–5% quarter-on-quarter, with every product category heading lower from Q2.

Industry capital spending is expected to climb 26.7% to $29.9 billion, and the shift to QLC and taller layer-count NAND should lift bit supply 25–30% for the year.

Demand is the problem. Enterprise SSDs are still the industry’s main growth engine, but the two biggest regions are pulling apart, said TrendForce. U.S. cloud providers have raised their 2027 outlook again, backed by AI agent and server builds already underway.

According to the firm, Chinese providers are heading the other way. GPU shortages, bloated inventories and a fight over token pricing have led them to cut 2027 SSD orders by more than U.S. buyers are adding.

TrendForce trimmed its Q4 2026 contract price increase forecast to 8% –13%, and spot prices have dropped more than 20% as distributors clear inventory.

SanDisk Shifts Focus To Data Center Customers 

SanDisk’s pitch is that its business has changed. CEO David Goeckeler told the Morgan Stanley Asia Pacific summit that the company has deliberately pivoted toward data center customers. It has eight such customers, three of them U.S. hyperscalers, and they want supply certainty over the lowest price.

“And they're willing to go there with us, sign contracts, put financial guarantees aside, give us certainty of economics, not just give us certainty of demand,” said Goeckeler.

TrendForce says the outlook hinges on how fast Chinese providers burn through inventory, and whether overseas GPU purchase restrictions change.

SNDK Stock: Retail View 

Retail sentiment around the stock remained ‘neutral’.

A user said, “This stock will 8x and be at this current pre- split price in less than 4 years.”

SNDK stock has surged 2,445% year-to-date.

data.title: US AI chip curbs hit China tech stocks, spur self-sufficiency push
data.description:
Key points:
  • New US rules target overseas data centres serving Chinese AI firms
  • Alibaba expects cloud growth to slow to 30% to 45% next year from 53%
  • Tencent says inference-heavy AI services can run on domestic chips

By Casey Hall and Sophie Yu

A flurry of US measures targeting China's access to advanced AI chips further pummelled Chinese technology stocks this week, as investors weigh whether Washington's latest curbs will slow Beijing's ambitions or accelerate its drive for technological self-sufficiency.

Chinese technology firms faced a series of new pressures, including US restrictions targeting Chinese firms' remote access to advanced AI chips, Nvidia's suspension of some chip shipments to China, a shareholder lawsuit against Alibaba and a US proposal that could require American companies to disclose their use of Chinese AI models.

Together, the developments show how the US-China contest for leadership in artificial intelligence is moving beyond semiconductor exports to cloud computing, software and corporate disclosure.

"Closing the gap at the leading edge before 2028, or even by 2030, looks difficult," Neil Shah, vice president of research at Counterpoint Research, said of the impact of US measures on China's AI industry.

The impact would be "far more prominent" in frontier model training than in inference, Shah said, adding that AI startups such as Moonshot AI, Z.AI , MiniMax and DeepSeek were more likely to be hit harder than hyperscalers such as Alibaba and Tencent .

Shares in leading Chinese tech companies have slumped since last week after Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang, who has pushed to preserve access to the Chinese market, resigned as CEO following reports that he had extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy.

Z.AI has tumbled 22% and MiniMax 34% over the last two weeks.

NEAR-TERM HIT

As Washington tightens curbs on access to advanced computing power, Chinese companies are racing to build a domestic AI ecosystem less dependent on US technology.

Executives at Tencent and Alibaba, two of China's biggest AI companies, said during earnings calls this week that the latest US restrictions would tighten computing constraints, though they differed on the near-term impact.

Tencent said its cloud business would be largely unaffected because its AI services rely mainly on inference workloads that can run on domestic chips.

But its President Martin Lau said the US restrictions would slow development of Tencent's next-generation AI model in the near term and accelerate China's shift towards domestic chips.

Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu also said the new US rule would affect its products and services next year, and could force the company to lower its long-term target of building 20 gigawatts of computing capacity.

While Alibaba maintained its long-term goal of generating $100 billion in external cloud revenue by 2030, cloud revenue growth was likely to slow to 30% to 45% next year from 53% in the latest quarter, as the company adjusts to the restrictions, it said.

"If (AI) training cycles become longer or the deployment of additional computing capacity slows, product iteration and commercialization could be delayed," said Liu Xingliang, a Beijing-based independent technology industry analyst.

DOMESTIC ALTERNATIVES

Both companies said domestic chips would play a growing role in meeting their computing needs. But China's capacity to manufacture advanced chips remains limited, with US export controls on ASML's immersion lithography machines and other tools limiting expansion.

Iluvatar CoreX , which supplies chips to ByteDance, said in a statement on its official WeChat account on Friday that it had built close ties with domestic semiconductor supply-chain partners to safeguard supplies, seeking to ease market concerns that had sent its shares down 17%.

Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corp , China's top contract chip manufacturer, is widely regarded as the only Chinese foundry producing advanced chips at scale using a 7-nanometer process. Much of that capacity has been earmarked for Huawei's (HWT.UL) Ascend AI chips, while Hua Hong Semiconductor's capacity to make advanced chips remains relatively limited.

Alibaba's Wu said the market remained supply-constrained and that domestic computing capacity would become "the primary engine supporting cloud revenue growth."

The restrictions are also rippling through overseas suppliers. Following new US licensing requirements announced this week on overseas data centres serving Chinese AI companies, Taiwan's ​TSMC suspended some previously permitted advanced chip manufacturing orders from Chinese customers, Reuters reported on Thursday.

data.title: Accor's top investor calls for urgent leadership changes
data.description:
Accor's top shareholder, Parvus Asset Management Jersey, called for urgent changes in the hotel operator's leadership late on Thursday, citing prolonged underperformance and what the activist investor described as inconsistent strategic decisions.

"We have exhausted our efforts to engage privately. In our view, inconsistent messaging, particularly from the highest levels of leadership, and repeated changes in strategic direction have broken confidence," Parvus said in a statement, adding it would use all shareholder rights at its disposal to hold Accor's management accountable.

  • The investor, whose funds hold close to 15% of Accor's shares, said the group had "materially underperformed" its peers over the long term under CEO Sébastien Bazin

  • Accor shares have delivered significantly lower returns during Bazin's tenure than rivals including IHG , Hilton and Marriott , Parvus said

  • It attributed the gap to Accor's "unfocused" strategy, inconsistent capital allocation and inadequate oversight

  • The investor also criticised Accor's handling of lifestyle hospitality venture Ennismore

  • "Accor faces its most consequential capital-allocation decisions in a decade, with significant strategic choices still to be made ... an outgoing leadership team should not be setting long-term strategy nor make any large capital-allocation decisions," Parvus said

  • Accor's shares slid 1% in early trading, in line with the overall downbeat European markets

data.title: Vinci Gets $439 Million Contract to Build LNG Tank in Canada
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

Vinci said it has been awarded a contract valued at around 400 million euros ($438.7 million) to build a new liquefied natural gas tank in Canada.

The French construction and infrastructure group said Friday that the contract, from JGC Fluor BC LNG II Joint Venture, will see it build a 225,000 cubic meter tank for the LNG Canada liquefied natural gas export terminal in Kitimat, British Columbia.

The contract is part of LNG Canada's Phase 2 expansion and comes after Vinci completed the site's first 225,000 cubic meter tank in 2025.

data.title: Hungarian Forint Falls Sharply on Rate-Cut Prospects, Risk Aversion — Market Talk
data.description: The Hungarian forint remains under pressure after reaching a seven-month low against the euro overnight on the prospect of the National Bank of Hungary cutting interest rates and risk aversion. data.title: Leads Biolabs Presents Opamtistomig (PD-L1/4-1BB Bispecific Antibody) to Global Investors at the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
data.description:
Long-Tail Survival Evidence Points to the Global Potential of IO 2.0

NANJING, China, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nanjing Leads Biolabs Co., Ltd. ("Leads Biolabs" or the "Company," Stock Code: 9887.HK) presented the differentiated profile of opamtistomig (LBL-024) to global pharmaceutical companies and investors at the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London, underscoring the therapy's global competitiveness in next-generation immuno-oncology (IO 2.0).

Dr. Kang Xiaoqiang, the Company's founder, Chairman and CEO, delivered the invited presentation. He built it around three lines of evidence: the mechanism and clinical evidence behind long-tail survival, activity across tumor types, and safety.

The clinical data support opamtistomig's potential as a pan-tumor IO 2.0 backbone therapy with durable survival benefit. Results from multiple trials point to activity in settings where conventional immunotherapy has limited reach. Those include low response rates, immunologically "cold" tumors, and tumors with negative or low PD-L1 expression. Deep responses in major indications and a doubling of median overall survival (OS) versus historical data in refractory cold tumors reinforce that positioning. Together, the findings outline five dimensions of value for a next-generation immunotherapy backbone.

(1) Long-term survival potential and managing cancer as a chronic disease: every indication with sufficiently long follow-up — including first-line combination chemotherapy and last-line monotherapy — has shown long-tail survival benefit. Median OS in extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma (EP-NEC) doubled compared with historical data. In small cell lung cancer (SCLC), median OS remains immature at 18 months of follow-up. Among the first 18 patients with NSCLC, follow-up has passed 12 months and the survival trend is encouraging. With mature follow-up, monotherapy also produced markedly longer OS in later-line biliary tract cancer (BTC), hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), ovarian cancer (OC) and other cold tumors. The findings suggest advanced cancer may become a chronic disease managed over the long term.

(2) Broad-spectrum efficacy: to date, breakthrough efficacy has been demonstrated in seven tumor types, supporting the potential to become a next-generation broad-spectrum immunotherapy backbone.

(3) Breakthroughs in cold tumors: to date, breakthrough efficacy has been demonstrated in five immunologically cold tumor types, offering the potential to overcome the efficacy limitations of first-generation immunotherapy.

(4) Coverage across patient populations: consistent trends of benefit have been observed in patients with positive, negative and low PD-L1 expression, offering the potential to cover a broader patient population.

(5) Excellent safety: more than 800 patients have received treatment, with no dose-limiting toxicities observed. The overall safety profile is similar to that of PD-(L)1 monoclonal antibodies, supporting long-term administration in broader patient populations.

At the conference, Leads Biolabs disclosed for the first time plans to launch several ADC combination programs in 2027. The programs include combinations with its in-house next-generation bispecific ADCs and T-cell engager ADCs (TCE-ADCs), as well as with ADCs from leading industry players.

Long-Tail Survival: A Mechanism Built on Long-Lived Memory T Cells

Opamtistomig is built with high affinity for PD-L1 and very low affinity for 4-1BB. The design enables conditional 4-1BB activation in the tumor microenvironment. Checkpoint blockade and co-stimulation therefore occur only within the tumor microenvironment. While avoiding hepatotoxicity caused by 4-1BB activation in normal tissues, this design reshapes the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. It significantly promotes T-cell activation and proliferation, stimulates abundant cytokine secretion and substantially reduces the number of regulatory T cells. Most importantly, it generates long-lived memory T cells. Those cells continue immune surveillance after treatment stops, which is the fundamental basis for opamtistomig’s ability to overcome the limitations of conventional immunotherapy and deliver durable survival benefits to patients.

Figure 1. Opamtistomig drives accumulation of 4-1BB-positive cells in tumors and markedly expands CD8+ T cells.

Clinical Data: Median OS Doubled in EP-NEC, with Long-Tail Trends in SCLC and Three Other Tumor Types

EP-NEC is the indication with the most mature survival data for opamtistomig. Long-term survival data have been reported from both first-line and heavily pretreated studies (2026 ESMO late-breaking abstract and selected oral presentation data).

In the pivotal registrational study of opamtistomig monotherapy in third-line or later EP-NEC (n=96), median follow-up was 16.3 months. Median OS was 8.7 months, versus approximately 3-4 months in historical data.

In first-line EP-NEC with combination chemotherapy (n=69), median follow-up was 21.2 months. Median OS was immature, and the 18-month OS rate was 55.7%. Historical median OS with first-line chemotherapy was 11.5-12.5 months.

In small cell lung cancer (SCLC), median follow-up has reached 18 months. OS data remain immature, and the long-term survival trend is encouraging. In monotherapy cohorts of heavily pretreated patients from an early basket trial, follow-up has passed two years and OS data are mature. All three tumor types showed encouraging long-tail benefit trends.

In third-line or later biliary tract cancer (BTC) (n=31), median OS was 7.5 months as a third-line or later treatment, numerically exceeding historical second-line data of 6.2 months with mFOLFOX and 5.3 months with regorafenib. In hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) previously treated with immunotherapy (n=14), median OS was 13.3 months. Historical second-line data were 10.6 months with regorafenib and 10.2 months with cabozantinib. In second-line or later ovarian cancer (OC) (n=11), median OS was 26.5 months. Historical second-line data with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy were 13.3 months.

The conference also included updated follow-up for the first 18 patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Follow-up reached 12.3 months, and responses continued to deepen. The data also point to long-tail potential.

All subtypes showed responses lasting longer than historical median progression-free survival (PFS) for standard treatment in the same indication. Every patient still on treatment had maintained a response for about 12 months. Historical median PFS was approximately 3-4 months in immunotherapy-pretreated non-squamous NSCLC, 8-9 months in first-line non-squamous NSCLC and about 7 months in first-line squamous NSCLC.

Prolonged responses were seen in PD-L1-positive and squamous populations. Two PD-L1-positive patients with first-line non-squamous disease and five patients with first-line squamous disease had each remained on treatment for more than 357 days. All were still on treatment. The Company views these durations as a meaningful survival signal and sees competitive potential against other bispecific antibodies.

Many patients remained in response at longer follow-up. The Company had presented these 18 patients at the 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer (WCLC), when median follow-up was about 10 months. Compared with that update, nine patients remained on treatment at the longer follow-up and only two additional progressions were recorded. That pattern is consistent with the course of cancer treatment.

Figure 2. Updated follow-up data for 18 patients with NSCLC presented at the Company's first R&D Day on Oct. 31, 2025 (Cohort 1A: immunotherapy-pretreated non-squamous NSCLC; Cohort 2A: first-line non-squamous NSCLC; Cohort 2B: first-line squamous NSCLC).

Broad Activity: Responses in Seven Tumor Types and Six Oral Presentations at Major Congresses

Responses have been observed repeatedly in seven indications, including the major indication of NSCLC and five immunologically "cold" tumor types. Studies have been selected six times for oral presentations at leading international oncology congresses, including the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO), the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) and the World Conference on Lung Cancer (WCLC).

Figure 3. Opamtistomig has received seven global regulatory designations and marketing application acceptances, and has been selected for six oral presentations at leading international oncology congresses.

First-Line NSCLC (2026 WCLC Oral Presentation Data)

In the squamous cohort (n=31), median follow-up was 7.4 months. The objective response rate (ORR) was 87.1% and the disease control rate (DCR) was 96.8%. The six-month PFS rate reached 86.7%. Patients with positive and negative PD-L1 expression showed consistent benefit trends. ORRs were 84.6% and 88.2%, respectively. Six-month PFS rates were 84.6% and 87.4%, respectively.

In the non-squamous cohort (n=31), median follow-up was 6.9 months. ORR was 54.8% and DCR was 93.5%. In the PD-L1-positive subgroup, ORR reached 81.8% and DCR reached 100.0%. The six-month PFS rate reached 90.0%. Responses were also seen in patients with low PD-L1 expression, with a tumor proportion score of 1%-49%.

First-Line BTC (2026 ESMO Poster Data)

In the overall population (n=20), median follow-up was 8.6 months. ORR was 70.0% and DCR was 95%. Median PFS was 8.0 months, and the six-month OS rate was 90.0%. In the PD-L1-positive subgroup, ORR was 100.0% and the six-month OS rate was 100.0%. In the PD-L1-negative subgroup, ORR was 50.0% and DCR was 91.7%. Median PFS was 7.2 months, and the six-month OS rate was 83.3%.

First-Line HCC

Data were updated with a larger sample and longer follow-up than the 2026 interim results disclosure. In the overall population (n=23), median follow-up was approximately seven months. ORR was 43.5% and DCR was 82.6%. In the PD-L1-positive subgroup, ORR was 50% and DCR was 75%. The subgroup grew from five to 12 patients since the 2026 interim results, with the response level holding steady.

First-Line Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma (ESCC)

Data were updated with longer follow-up than the 2026 interim results disclosure. In the overall population (n=20), median follow-up was approximately 5.5 months. ORR was 70% and DCR was 90%. In the PD-L1-positive subgroup, ORR was 77.8% and DCR was 100%.

Platinum-Resistant OC

In the overall population (n=12), median follow-up was approximately 2.5 months. ORR was 16.7% and DCR was 66.7%. Neither median PFS nor median OS had been reached. In the PD-L1-positive subgroup, ORR was 40% and DCR was 80%. Neither median PFS nor median OS had been reached.

First-Line SCLC

ORR was 88.1% and DCR was 96.6%. As of October 2026, median follow-up was 18 months and OS data remained immature.

EP-NEC

Data from multiple clinical studies of monotherapy in previously treated EP-NEC demonstrated consistent benefits across lines of therapy. In second-line, second-line or later, and third-line or later settings, ORRs were 38.1%, 33.3% and 26.0%, respectively. Median PFS was 4.1, 2.8 and 1.4 months, respectively. Median OS was 11.8, 11.9 and 8.7 months, respectively.

In first-line EP-NEC with combination chemotherapy, ORR was 69.2% and DCR was 90.8%. Median PFS was 5.7 months. Median OS was immature, and the 18-month OS rate was 55.7%.

Safety: More Than 800 Patients Treated With No Dose-Limiting Toxicities

Hepatotoxicity has long limited the clinical use of 4-1BB agonists. Opamtistomig's conditional 4-1BB activation is designed to address that challenge at the mechanistic level. To date, more than 800 patients have received opamtistomig across 14 indications. No dose-limiting toxicities have been observed. The maximum tolerated dose was not reached even with dose escalation to 25 mg/kg. Safety and tolerability were similar across monotherapy and combination trials. The overall safety profile was similar to that of PD-(L)1 monoclonal antibodies. Those findings support longer-term dosing in broader populations and further study of combination regimens.

Building on the responses seen with opamtistomig plus chemotherapy in cold tumors, the Company plans to test combinations with antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). The approach retains the targeted cytotoxic effect of ADCs while using the immune system to clear tumor cells. The goal is a next-generation standard of care. Combinations under consideration include opamtistomig with an EGFR/PD-L1 ADC, a CDH17/CD3/ADC and a DLL3/CD3/ADC, as well as several ADCs from leading industry players. Beyond ADC combinations, the Company also plans to explore regimens with other molecules, including anti-VEGF agents and T-cell engagers (TCEs), to establish new standards of care in specific tumor types.

Figure 4. Planned combination studies for opamtistomig.

During the conference, the Company's senior management held a series of closed-door, one-on-one business development and investor meetings. Discussions with overseas institutions covered registration timelines by indication, global clinical development plans, commercialization strategy and pipeline synergies.

Executive Commentary

"Taking part in Jefferies was about more than sharing clinical data," said Dr. Kang Xiaoqiang, founder, Chairman and CEO of Leads Biolabs. "It let us present the full logic behind our differentiated innovation to global investors and industry partners. It also helped advance our global registration plans and international partnerships.

"Cancer immunotherapy has entered the IO 2.0 era. Opamtistomig's value lies in a manageable safety profile and the potential for long overall survival benefit across tumor types. Together, those features offer a new treatment framework in areas that conventional immunotherapy has struggled to reach."

About the Jefferies Global Healthcare ConferenceHosted by U.S. investment bank Jefferies, the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference is one of the world's largest healthcare investment summits. The 2026 invitation-only meeting took place Nov. 16-19 at The Waldorf Hilton, London and ME London, alongside London Life Sciences Week. The conference covers biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, medical devices and healthcare services. Company presentations, one-to-one and small-group investor meetings, and panel discussions focus on near- and longer-term investment opportunities and industry trends in global healthcare.

About Opamtistomig

Opamtistomig (LBL-024) is emerging as a next-generation pan-cancer backbone therapy with potential overall survival (OS) benefit that simultaneously targets PD-L1 and the co-stimulatory receptor 4-1BB. Currently, opamtistomig is being evaluated in 14 indications, including one pivotal single-arm registrational study, one confirmatory Phase III study, and nine proof-of-concept studies, covering major indications such as NSCLC and multiple cold tumors. To date, opamtistomig has demonstrated robust antitumor activity across seven tumor types—extrapulmonary neuroendocrine carcinoma (EP-NEC), non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), small cell lung cancer (SCLC), biliary tract cancer (BTC), hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), and ovarian cancer (OC)—highlighting its clinical value and broad therapeutic promise.

Developed using Leads Biolabs’ proprietary X-body bispecific platform, opamtistomig is designed to simultaneously block PD-1/PD-L1 immune suppression and conditionally activate 4-1BB, an agonist pathway, resulting in a potent and synergistic anti-tumor immune response. It has a safety profile comparable to PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors and demonstrates broader-spectrum anti-cancer potential. Mechanistically, 4-1BB agonism can reactivate exhausted T cells and promote robust T-cell proliferation, offering significant promise for PD-1/PD-L1–resistant or immunologically “cold” tumors and potentially offering durable survival benefits.

Recognizing its clinical potential in EP-NEC, opamtistomig received Breakthrough Therapy Designation from China's National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) in October 2024, Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in November 2024, Fast Track Designation from the FDA and ODD from the European Commission in January 2026, and ODD from Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) in September 2026. In October 2026, the FDA granted a second Fast Track Designation, this one for first-line advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer.

In July 2026, its New Drug Application (NDA) was granted priority review designation by the NMPA, followed by NDA acceptance in August 2026, positioning opamtistomig as a potential world's first approved 4-1BB-targeting antibody, the first approved agonist antibody, and the first approved treatment for EP-NEC.

About Leads Biolabs

Founded in 2012, Leads Biolabs is a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative therapies to address underserved medical needs in oncology, autoimmune, and other severe diseases both in China and globally.

Leads Biolabs is a front-runner in next-generation immuno-oncology treatments with a differentiated pipeline of 15 innovative drug candidates, including five clinical-stage drug candidates and one registration-stage asset.

The Company adopts a science-driven R&D approach and has successfully established comprehensive R&D capabilities spanning antibody discovery and engineering, in vivo and in vitro efficacy evaluation, as well as druggability assessment. data.title: U.K. Could Struggle to Maintain Fiscal Rules Given Weak Public Finances — Market Talk
data.description: U.K. public finances remain stretched, which could challenge the government's ability to maintain its fiscal rules, Pantheon Macroeconomics' Rob Wood and Elliott Jordan-Doak say in a note. The latest data show public borrowing stood at 17 billion pounds ($22 billion) in October, a 5.2% increase from a year ago. The October budget failed to address the main challenges facing U.K. finances, meaning the fiscal position could deteriorate further, the economists say. "We continue to have doubts about the government's ability to follow through on its fiscal plans, suggesting upside risks to borrowing in the coming years." (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)

data.title: PowerX, Averroes to explore BESS opportunities in the Gulf region
data.description:
November 20 (Renewables Now) - Japanese battery systems maker PowerX Inc will partner with Dubai-based tech company Averroes Tech Manufacturing to explore supplying its battery energy storage systems (BESS) to the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) market.

Under the agreement, the two companies will jointly identify BESS projects and offer PowerX’s containerised battery solutions, including the 10-foot Mega Power 2500 and 20-foot Mega Power 4000, along with the Grid Connector package, which combines a power conversion system, transformer and switchgear. The configuration will depend on each project's requirements, PowerX announced on Thursday.

The Japanese manufacturer will provide the equipment and design and technical specifications. Averroes will be in charge of customer engagement, local permitting, installation and after-sales service.

“This partnership brings advanced Japanese battery energy storage technology and engineering to the GCC. For Averroes, it is the first step in long-term Japanese–GCC industrial cooperation, supporting the region’s energy security, grid resilience and the integration of renewable energy,” said Abdullah Ahmad AlFarhan, Co-Founder & Executive Director of Averroes.

PowerX noted that the collaboration will start with joint sales activities and, if proven successful, can include a joint venture and local assembly in the region.

data.title: SM Investments' nine-month net income rises 9% to PHP70 billion
data.description:
PASAY CITY, Philippines, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SM Investments Corporation (SM), the parent company of the SM Group, reported consolidated net income of PHP70.2 billion in the first nine months of 2026, up 9% from PHP64.4 billion a year earlier.

Consolidated revenues increased 5% to PHP506.8 billion from PHP482.3 billion. Banking contributed 48% of consolidated net income, followed by property at 26%, retail at 15% and portfolio investments at 11%.

"Ongoing resilient consumer demand supported retail and malls, while portfolio investments delivered stronger earnings," said Frederic C. DyBuncio, President and Chief Executive Officer of SM Investments.

Consumer resilience

SM Retail posted net income of PHP13.1 billion, up 7% from the previous year, as consolidated revenues grew 5.4% to PHP335.3 billion. Growth was broad-based, supported by resilient consumer spending.

Food retail posted steady sales growth across its supermarket and minimart formats, reflecting continued demand for everyday essentials.

Specialty retail recorded higher sales, supported by demand for power-source alternatives and spending on selected discretionary categories, particularly toys, stationery and pet products.

Revenues from the Group's mall business increased 10% to PHP63.7 billion due to an increase in leasable space, higher occupancy and strong demand for dining and experiential offerings.

BDO Unibank's loan portfolio grew 16%, with double-digit increases across all segments while China Banking Corporation reported a 19% jump in net loans.

Portfolio performance

Meanwhile, portfolio investments accounted for 11% of consolidated net income, led by a turnaround in Atlas Consolidated Mining and Development Corporation as higher copper prices supported earnings.

2GO Group, Inc. recorded revenue growth of 15%, supported by strong performance across its businesses, particularly sea travel and container services.

Philippine Geothermal Production Company, Inc.'s 13% higher revenues were driven by higher steam prices which track the Wholesale Electricity Spot Market (WESM).

The parent advantage

The SM Group's businesses are largely in sectors that deliver strong predictable cashflows. Over 60% of parent annual cashflows are from non-listed businesses, including SM Retail, in addition to the dividends regularly received from listed subsidiaries.

All established businesses fund their own operations and expansion plans and do not require funding from the parent. With a strong balance sheet and reliable cash generation, SM Investments seeks to increase its returns to shareholders via higher dividends and an active share buyback program.

Total assets stood at PHP1.8 trillion as of September 30, 2026, with net debt-to-equity of 31:69.

"At the parent, we continue to allocate capital carefully and maintain the financial capacity to invest for the long term," Mr. DyBuncio said.

About SM Investments Corporation

SM Investments Corporation (SM) is an owner-operator of market-leading businesses in retail, banking, and property, with investments in high-growth opportunities in the Philippine economy. Through its portfolio, SM generates resilient cash flows and reinvests with discipline to compound value over the long term.

Its retail operations are the largest and most diversified in the country. Its property arm, SM Prime Holdings, Inc., is the largest integrated property developer in the Philippines. Its banking interests include BDO Unibank, Inc., the country's largest bank, and China Banking Corporation, one of the country's largest private domestic banks.

For more information, please visit www.sminvestments.com

SOURCE SM Investments Corporation

data.title: SEC charges eight firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
data.description:
The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) charged eight Colorado-based entities with defrauding US investors of more than $37 million.

The defendants allegedly lured investors by masquerading as investment advisers or representatives of crypto asset trading platforms, which the SEC described as fronts designed to steal investor money, the agency announced in a Thursday press release.

The SEC said individuals overseas likely operated the entities and used social media ads to lure investors into private chat groups. They first offered stock-trading advice before persuading victims to transfer money to fake crypto platforms, where victims believed they were buying genuine crypto assets. The perpetrators created fake SEC certificates and submitted filings with the SEC, FINRA and FinCEN to feign legitimacy.

The SEC previously warned investors that scammers used investment-related group chats to promote fraud schemes, including by impersonating financial professionals, according to a December 2025 alert.

The scheme allegedly operated through four successive adviser-platform pairs from August 2024 to May 2026, with operators switching pairs every few months.

The eight entities charged were Advisor WeChat Capital, Tech Brokerage Asset Alliance Ltd., HB Wealth Advisors, IdeaCrypto Exchange LLC, Convergent Wealth Advisors Inc., RealSimple Crypto Exchange Inc., Associated Wealth Advisors Ltd., and Essential Crypto Exchange.

“The SEC continues to seek out and expose fraudulent investment scams that prey on U.S. investors,” said Laura D’Allaird, chief of the SEC Enforcement Division’s Cyber and Emerging Technologies Unit, encouraging the public to report such schemes through its online portal.

During fiscal year 2026, the SEC filed 348 enforcement actions, down 23.7% from 456 a year earlier. The SEC filed 13 crypto-related actions in calendar year 2025, down from 33 in 2024, according to Cornerstone Research.

data.title: Oil Prices Edge Higher as Traders Assess Middle East Shipping Risks, Supply Outlook
data.description:
By Farhan Rafid

DOHA, Qatar--Oil prices edged higher Friday as traders assessed continued threats to Middle Eastern oil shipments and improving global supply conditions.

Front-month Brent crude futures rose 0.5% to $92.47 a barrel, while front-month West Texas Intermediate crude futures gained 0.6% to $83.69 a barrel.

Both benchmarks have fallen around 15% so far this month as U.S. President Trump held off on renewed large-scale strikes against Iran. A stronger U.S. dollar and broader weakness across commodity markets have also added to pressure on oil prices.

The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday that Israel's spy chief had urged U.S. officials to support renewed strikes against Iran, while Gulf countries pressed for negotiations amid concerns about retaliatory attacks on regional infrastructure. Trump is weighing whether to resume a broader military campaign against Tehran.

Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia said Thursday that a Houthi attack damaged several floors of a tower in Riyadh's financial district, with no injuries reported, according to the Saudi Press Agency. The Wall Street Journal identified the building as the headquarters of the kingdom's Public Investment Fund.

Pavel Molchanov, an investment strategist at Raymond James, said Thursday that oil markets have become increasingly accustomed to periodic tensions in the Middle East, provided they don't escalate into a broader conflict. He said production among OPEC's Persian Gulf members had recovered to 87% of prewar levels as the industry adapted to disruptions.

Meanwhile, the U.S. Energy Information Administration said Thursday that oil shipments through major Middle Eastern shipping routes increased 19% in the third quarter from the previous three months, as producers used smaller vessels and alternative infrastructure to maintain exports.

The agency said shipments through the Strait of Hormuz and Suez Canal increased, while flows through the Bab el-Mandeb declined. Preliminary shipping data from Vortexa indicated that shipments remained near third-quarter levels in October.

Middle Eastern crude production reached 23.1 million barrels a day in October, the highest since the conflict began, according to the EIA.

The International Energy Agency said Thursday that the response in oil prices to the disruption around the Strait of Hormuz had been less severe than the scale of the supply shock might have suggested, amid ample global supply and well-stocked inventories.

In its World Energy Outlook, the agency said the global oil market was expected to return to a surplus as Middle Eastern production recovered faster than demand. It projects an oversupply of 1.7 million barrels a day in the fourth quarter, widening to about 3.8 million barrels a day next year.

The agency also said prolonged disruptions to shipping through the strait could accelerate investment in alternative export routes, with around 7 million barrels a day of new pipeline capacity under construction or consideration. The projects would require an estimated $40 billion in investment, adding about $2 to the cost of each barrel of Middle Eastern oil exported.

Write to Farhan Rafid at farhan.rafid@wsj.com

data.title: P&G Plans To Cut Up To 30% Product Supply Jobs By 2030; Confirms FY27 Outlook
data.description:
CINCINNATI (dpa-AFX) - Consumer goods giant Procter & Gamble Co. or P&G announced its plans for a ?20 percent to 30 percent reduction in product supply workforce, including contractors, by 2030. The firm targets up to $10 billion in productivity savings from ?fiscal years 2027-2030. The move is part of its productivity restructuring efforts amid the increasing pressure on supply-chain costs.

At its Investor Day on Thursday, the firm also maintained fiscal 2027 forecast for net sales growth of 2 to 4 percent and organic sales growth of 1 to 3 percent.

For the first half of fiscal 2027, the firm projects net sales growth on a reported and organic basis at around 3 percent, compared to around 2 percent organic growth in the second half of fiscal 2026 and 1 percent in the first half.

Over the long term, the firm projects core earnings per share to grow in mid- to high single digits, with improved margin, and organic sales to grow ahead of the market, with share growth.

The company projects $30 billion in opportunities for growth.

As part of the cost savings target, the company aims for up to $1.8 billion in annual productivity savings, reportedly from cost of goods sold. The job cuts are in line with the firm's ongoing effort to lower supply-chain costs.

While announcing the first-quarter results in late October, P&G had stated that it expects a commodity cost headwind of approximately $1.4 billion after tax driven by higher raw materials, energy and transportation costs, among others, which would result in a headwind of $0.79 per share for fiscal 2027, or an eleven percent drag on core earnings per share growth.

In its first quarter, the company recorded slightly lower net profit at $4.731 billion, as the 4 percent increase in net sales to $23.276 billion was partially offset by an increase in operating costs. Earnings per share, however, was higher than last year.

Earlier in June 2025, the firm had announced a portfolio and productivity plan to streamline its portfolio and organization, aiming to improve its cost structure and competitiveness. The company then expected to incur around $2 billion in before-tax restructuring costs over two years and has incurred over half of the costs under this plan in fiscal 2026. The remainder is expected to be incurred in fiscal 2027.

In the overnight activity on the NYSE, the shares were gaining around 0.30 percent at $168.35, after closing Thursday's regular trading 1.43 percent lower.

data.title: Retail sales spike after government urges households to stock up
data.description:
According to the Office for National Statistics, retail sales volumes jumped 0.7%, reversing September’s downwardly revised fall of 0.6%. Analysts had been expecting flat sales. Year-on-year, sales spiked 2.3%, comfortably ahead of expectations for a 1.7% rise.

Over the three months to October, the quantity of goods bought rose 0.4%, driven by higher volumes at food stores. Supermarkets reported increased sales of long-life items such as UHT milk and tinned goods following the Be Ready campaign, which urged households to stock up on basics, including bottled water, in case essential services unexpectedly went down.

Fuel sales also recovered, the ONS noted, despite pump prices rising again.

Erin Brookes, European retail and consumer lead at consultancy Alvarez & Marsal, said: “Retailers will be feeling optimistic as the sector approaches the critical Black Friday and Christmas trading period.

“Despite this positivity, retailers are caught between increasingly price-sensitive consumers and mounting operating costs. With little scope to pass further increases onto shoppers, businesses face a difficult balancing act between offering compelling promotions and protecting already stretched margins. Black Friday will be a critical battleground.”

data.title: Michael Saylor sees up to $7.5 billion in ‘natural demand’ for Strategy’s STRC preferred stock
data.description:
Strategy (MSTR) Executive Chairman Michael Saylor said "natural, organic" demand for the company's STRC preferred stock at its current 12% dividend rate is likely between $5 billion and $7.5 billion.

"I don't know exactly where the number is, but I’m going to go out on a limb and say that somewhere between $5 billion and $7.5 billion, there is natural organic demand to hold the instrument at 12% dividend," Saylor said during a live investor Q&A on Thursday.

His comments come as Strategy has been actively repurchasing STRC shares at prices below its $100 stated level. President and CEO Phong Le said the company has bought back about $3 billion of the preferred stock at prices between $95 and $99, below the issuance price level.

Saylor described the current environment as a credit-market contraction that began around May. He said the company is responding by reducing the amount of STRC outstanding until it reaches an equilibrium level that the market will support at the existing dividend rate.

"We're going to contract the outstanding STRC because 12% is a fat dividend for an investment-grade instrument,” Saylor said. "As we buy it back, we lengthen the duration, we strip the risk, we improve the credit."

CEO Le also said that the recent buybacks have de-risked the company's balance sheet after credit markets tightened over the past four to five months. Le added that Strategy had previously expanded STRC from an initial $2.5 billion issuance to roughly $8 billion under favorable market conditions.

Like an insurance company

Saylor framed the support for STRC as important for the long-term credibility of the product. He compared it to an insurance company paying claims, arguing that failing to back the security in a weaker market would damage confidence among credit investors over multiple years.

"When the company is swapping either BTC or MSTR for STRC, we're supporting the credit, we're supporting the brand of the company, we're improving the product quality," Saylor said.

The Strategy Chairman also reiterated that the company has at least three years' worth of cash right now, so it will still be able to operate even if the current bitcoin (BTC) downturn continues.

The world's largest digital asset treasury firm owned 850,849 BTC as of Nov. 15, according to its latest disclosure, which amounts to more than 4% of bitcoin's maximum supply cap. Last month, holders of Strategy's STRC, STRF, STRK and STRD preferred shares approved a change allowing dividends to accrue daily, rather than on the previous schedule.

Last week, the company sold approximately $244.7 million in MSTR shares to fund bitcoin purchases and STRC repurchases.

data.title: Good Design Meets Good Care - OMRON Healthcare Wins Two German Design Awards 2027
data.description:
KYOTO, Japan, Nov 20, 2026 - (JCN Newswire) - OMRON Healthcare Co., Ltd. today announced that its Mesh Nebulizer NE-U300 and Ear Thermometer MC-E533 have each been named a Winner at the German Design Award 2027. Both products were honored in the Medical, Rehabilitation and Health Care category of the Excellent Product Design discipline.

The German Design Award is organized by the German Design Council, which was established in 1953. It is an internationally recognized design competition that celebrates excellence in product design, communications, and architecture. An independent international jury judges entries on criteria such as design quality and functionality.

The Mesh Nebulizer NE-U300 is designed to make home respiratory care easier and more affordable. Its innovative design simplifies every stage of inhalation therapy, from preparing the medication to inhaling it and cleaning the device. A magnetically detachable medication bottle, a wide bottle opening, and a simplified structure make the nebulizer easier to use while helping keep costs down, supporting wider access to respiratory care at home. The device is available in Europe, China, Asia-Pacific, and Brazil.

The Ear Thermometer MC-E533 was also recognized for its child-friendly design and ease of use. It provides quick temperature readings with minimal discomfort. With the sensor positioned at the tip of the probe, parents can easily take accurate measurements. Easy-to-press buttons and an alcohol-cleanable probe also make it convenient to use, eliminating the need for disposable probe covers. In addition, silent mode and a backlit display allow parents to check their child's temperature without disturbing them, even while they sleep. The device is available in Europe, China, Asia-Pacific, and India.

"Good design is about more than appearance," said, Ms. Tamaki Ito, General Manager, Brand Experience Strategy Department, OMRON Healthcare Co., Ltd. "It means creating products that are accurate, intuitive, and easy to fit into everyday life. We are honored that these efforts have been recognized by the German Design Award, and we will continue to develop meaningful design solutions that help people around the world monitor and manage their health."

About OMRON Healthcare

Committed to advancing health and empowering people worldwide to live life to the fullest, OMRON Healthcare is a global leader in the field of clinically proven, innovative medical equipment for home health monitoring and treatment. Aiming to realize its vision, "Going for ZERO, Preventive Care for the Health of Society," the company develops products for cardiovascular condition management, respiratory care, and pain therapy. Building on this, it has introduced a new digital health ecosystem that bridges patients and healthcare professionals, helping to reduce cerebro-cardiovascular events, the worsening of respiratory diseases, and limitations caused by chronic pain.

With over 400 million units sold globally*, OMRON has established a leading global presence in home blood pressure monitoring. Throughout its history, OMRON Healthcare has striven to improve lives and contribute to a better society by developing innovations that help people prevent, treat, and manage their medical conditions, providing products and services in over 130 countries. OMRON Healthcare Group is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

* Cumulative sales of home-use digital blood pressure monitors worldwide. (as of September 2025)

data.title: Vinci Gets $439 Million Contract to Build LNG Tank in Canada
data.description:
By Dominic Chopping

Vinci said it has been awarded a contract valued at around 400 million euros ($438.7 million) to build a new liquefied natural gas tank in Canada.

The French construction and infrastructure group said Friday that the contract, from JGC Fluor BC LNG II Joint Venture, will see it build a 225,000 cubic meter tank for the LNG Canada liquefied natural gas export terminal in Kitimat, British Columbia.

The contract is part of LNG Canada's Phase 2 expansion and comes after Vinci completed the site's first 225,000 cubic meter tank in 2025.
